given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled including product name and price
given_when_then.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

given_when_then.given: A product entry exists with a previous archived version
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits a product entry update with all required fields filled
given_when_then.then: The system updates the product details, archives the previous version, and displays the new entry as the current version

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry
given_when_then.when: The product entry is in an archived state
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the update request and prevents modification

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry
given_when_then.when: The submitted update request is missing required fields such as product name or price
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the specific missing field

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser submits a product update request
given_when_then.when: The request includes the user identifier and timestamp
given_when_then.then: The system records the change metadata alongside the updated product details

success_criteria: The system successfully creates a new product entry when all required fields (product name, price) are populated.
The new product entry is automatically assigned as the current version upon creation.
The system successfully updates existing product details when submitted with valid data.
Previous versions of the product are automatically retained and marked as archived upon a new version publish.
The system prevents updates to product entries that are currently in an archived state.
The system rejects update requests containing missing required fields and displays a specific error message.
